site.machinery: world.js PUBLIC_VENUE_PLANS and makePublicVenue('venue:amphitheatre'); VENUE_COLUMNS 30, VENUE_ROWS 22, arrival { x: entrance, y: rows - 2 } and the single 'Return to the Commons' portal on the arrival tile

independence.statement: A fictional NemoWorld space. It is not a government, ministry, embassy or United Nations office, it does not represent any country or people, and nothing here asserts endorsement, representation or official status.

notes: A paved stage inside a grass bowl with a two-course bench ring, on the public venue plan world.js already builds from the Commons doorway at (42,20).

The portal sits on the arrival tile for a venue plan, unlike a country venue where the portal is the tile south of the arrival; the place records both, so the two conventions cannot be swapped by accident.
